corpus_fingerprint.input: sorted language labels and stable chunk identifiers from eval_set.jsonl and grounding_set.jsonl; no source text

authorized_local_release_checks: live retrieval metrics against the established local corpus
full inference-backend checks with existing local model artifacts
future_provider_checks: answer quality and semantic support review
known_limitations: The retrieval ranking is a deterministic fixture replay, not a live retriever measurement.
Citation membership does not prove semantic entailment.
Route checks measure the deterministic quarantine guard, not provider route accuracy.
Number-word support is a small reviewed lexicon, not general semantic number parsing.
Code-mixed and transliterated language handling remains a labeled limitation.
No provider, database, model download, or cloud service is used by this evaluation.
